description: Data Access Object (DAO) interface for CRUD operations on recipe entities in a local database, using Room persistence library.

classes.name: RecipeDao
classes.description: Interface defining DAO for recipe data operations, annotated with @Dao for Room integration.

methods.name: getAllRecipes
methods.description: Retrieves all recipes ordered by title.

methods.name: searchRecipes
methods.description: Searches recipes by query matching title or description.

methods.name: getFavoriteRecipes
methods.description: Retrieves all recipes marked as favorites.

methods.name: insertRecipe
methods.description: Inserts a new recipe into the database, replacing on conflict.

methods.name: setFavorite
methods.description: Sets the favorite status for a recipe by id.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a recipe by its id.
